insight.headline: GraphQL Admin API Error
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to handle the new error response. They should also review their metafield configurations to ensure they are set up correctly for filtering. The `metafield` object in the GraphQL schema now includes a `filterable` property that indicates whether a metafield can be used in a filter. Developers can use this property to determine which metafields are safe to use in their queries.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice more accurate results from GraphQL queries, as incorrect results are now returned as errors instead of being silently ignored.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the reliability and accuracy of the GraphQL Admin API, helping developers build more robust and trustworthy integrations with Shopify.

Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events

updates.title: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers
updates.summary: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API. This feature enables extensions to discover and send documents to connected receipt printers.

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, starting in API version 2026-10. This change prevents silently returning incorrect results.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources and metafield changes.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, introducing a simpler way to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, simplifying the process of building merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview introduces a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI version 4.5.2 fixes a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen version 13.0.2 adds non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags and allows bypassing confirmation prompts in hydrogen upgrade.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include the use of a unique name for apps, reducing merchant confusion over identical and copied app names.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API @inContext directive now supports the channelId argument, allowing the application of a specific sales channel's context to an entire query.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle fields, providing more detailed information about exchange line items.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance POS, GraphQL, and Liquid capabilities

themes.title: POS and Printing
themes.detail: The POS UI extensions now support direct printing to hardware receipt printers using the shopify.printing API. This update streamlines the printing process for merchants, improving their overall customer experience.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API and Events
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, ensuring more accurate results. Additionally, new event topics are available for metafield changes, orders, collections, and more, allowing for more targeted app subscriptions and reactions.

themes.title: Liquid and Theme Development
themes.detail: Liquid templates have been enhanced with the ability to compose pages using blocks and partials, simplifying theme development. This update makes it easier for developers to build and maintain complex page structures directly within Liquid templates.

actions.text: Update POS UI extensions to utilize the new Printing API
Review and adjust GraphQL Admin API queries for metafield filtering
Explore new event topics for app subscriptions and integrations
